name: rake
title: Rake
description: Search and run Rake tasks from a configurable directory, with support for task arguments.
author: kdmsnr

preferences.name: rakePath
preferences.title: Rake Executable
preferences.description: Path to the rake executable, e.g. ~/.rbenv/shims/rake. Leave empty to use rake from PATH.

preferences.name: directory
preferences.title: Rake Directory
preferences.description: Directory used to discover and run Rake tasks. Defaults to your home directory.

commands.name: rake
commands.title: Run Rake Task
commands.description: Search Rake tasks in your configured directory and run them with optional arguments.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Use npm run publish to submit this extension to the Raycast Store.'); process.exit(1)"
